rationale: Block 6 covers chronic osteomyelitis with sequestrum and involucrum — key vocabulary that trips up students
Block 14 directly addresses distinguishing TB (indolent) from pyogenic infection — a high-yield differential
Block 11 covers septic arthritis aetiopathogenesis including hip as orthopaedic emergency — applies understanding to management urgency
Block 8 directly covers Kocher criteria — the primary trap for this SDL; Apply level requires selecting correct score interpretation
Block 7 covers synovial fluid analysis thresholds — a key factual anchor; TF tests the WCC >50,000 criterion for septic arthritis
Block 3 covers indications and contraindications — tests the key absolute contraindication (overlying skin infection)
Block 6 covers sequestrectomy and saucerisation — central operative procedure; tests when sequestrectomy is indicated and what saucerisation achieves
Block 3 covers indications for operative source control — tests the core principle that sequestrum presence always mandates surgery
Block 9 covers intraoperative findings and interpretation — tests ability to analyse unexpected operative findings and adjust management
